about: The Marlin-2B serving version (W3): serve.sh's pinned default, verified by tests/w/test_serving.py (check_pinned_launch). `flags` is what serve.sh passes after the image on a launch with no extra arguments, with ${NAME} for the two settings. Flags a caller appends pass through to vLLM and are outside this record (a new serving version); a second value for either setting, or an --api-key, is refused, and the environment cannot change the image, --max-model-len or --gpu-memory-utilization. `engine_options_digest` is sha256 of the flags' compact JSON with `settings` substituted.

runtime_image.pilot_box: meas. 2026-09-23, research/plan/evidence/w/box/inventory-20260923T0319Z.txt (SSM command 6a8569bd-e958-4a1d-9797-6496e0b12b42, 2026-09-23T03:19:48Z): image_equals_pin=yes - the running container's image id is sha256:4cbfd34aac145fd1870381c030131c7f868fcad45448f401ecdb5fd4ed020b42 (the full digest above), RepoDigests [vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:4cbfd34a...20b42], tag :nightly, created 2026-09-19T05:47:54.316012075Z, ai.vllm.build.commit a8d1aa9c99b8698a2a78b611b7a10c30e6b3995b; docker 29.7.2 with storage driver `overlayfs`. The local id there is the INDEX digest, not the amd64 config digest: `overlayfs` is Docker's name for the containerd image store's snapshotter (the classic store reports `overlay2` and would show the config digest, 38e8c0e6...) - the equality is measured, the store is read from the driver name. The box still runs the pre-pin serve.sh (by tag): same image, but its flags carry --max-num-seqs 32 and no --allowed-local-media-path until I2B's pinned deploy

settings_status.ENGINE_MAX_NUM_SEQS: ⚠️ TO BE VERIFIED: the pilot value (contracts limits engine_max_num_seqs); the pilot box ran 32 (I1B), and still serves 32 (meas. 2026-09-23, container args). The sweep is held by the coordinator (P-04: it needs a checkout and a corpus build on the box), so until it runs the cutover sets 32 explicitly (I2B FC-1). measure/concurrency.sh measures it and refuses unless the engine serves --max-num-seqs 32, so the sweep runs either before the pinned unit is deployed (the box's current unit passes 32) or after `INFRX_SET=ENGINE_MAX_NUM_SEQS=32` through I2B's install.sh (the validated /etc/marlin2b-gateway.env, which the vLLM unit and the runtime both read) and a restart of marlin2b-vllm; the W3 evidence's predeclared rule then sets the value that replaces 8

kv_capacity.note: the capacity is the engine's own token count, 2,644,426 (= 80.70 x 32,768). num_gpu_blocks x block_size is 2,941,408 here, NOT the capacity: this hybrid model shares the block pool between linear-attention (mamba-style) state and attention pages (the log sets the attention block to 544 so the pages match), so E1B's formula overstates it; the reason for the exact gap is not derived here
